title: Equal-budget benchmark: PINN vs FNO vs DeepONet (pinneapple-benchmark experiment 09)
protocol: pp.benchmark: same wall-clock budget per training run on one CPU core (300 s Burgers, Darcy, Navier-Stokes; 900 s airfoil; 120 s inverse heat), an equal-trial hyper-parameter search, 3 seeds, correctness gates; test and OOD sets fixed before any run (see the experiment README).
note: Copied unchanged from the repository at this commit; the arena shows these numbers as published there and did not rerun them.
